editor.title: How letters land on the page.
editor.sub: Editor typography and focus behavior — independent of export.
editor.preview_p1: Silence spread between them like tidewater over stone. At last she spoke, her voice almost carried away by the wind, landing somewhere he could barely hear.
editor.preview_p2: “Will you come back?” He did not answer at once. He watched the sun sink into the sea, then nodded after a long while, though even he could not tell whether it was a promise or mercy.
editor.preview_p3: The wind came over the breakwater with salt and damp in it. She pulled her coat tighter, asked nothing more, and kept the question inside her instead.
editor.preview_p4: Far away, the lighthouse blinked on and off, as if counting things no one could say aloud. The waves folded every spoken and unspoken word into their noise.
editor.preview_p5: Years later, he still remembered that evening and the goodbye he never managed to say. Whenever sea wind crossed the window again, that silence returned as clearly as if it had never left. (This paragraph demonstrates Tab indent.)
editor.preview_p6: Afterward they walked into different lives. City lights dimmed the memory, then lit it again. But the sea, the sunset, and that hour kept returning on time.

agent.chatModelDesc: "Follow latest" uses aliases that track each tier's latest version; you can also pin a concrete version. Default leaves it to subscription or CLI.
agent.thinkingDesc: When on, the model thinks before answering. It is steadier for complex tasks; off is faster and cheaper. The thinking process appears in the chat.
agent.effortDesc: Applies when thinking is on. high is deepest by default, low is fastest; xhigh / max are only supported by some Opus versions.
agent.toolSearchDesc: About 49 tool definitions would otherwise stay in context at roughly 10k tokens. When enabled, tools are retrieved on demand and each turn loads only the relevant 3-5 tools. Auto triggers only when tool definitions cross the threshold, and is mostly off at this scale. Requires Sonnet 4+/Opus 4+; Haiku is unsupported.

agentMemory.desc: Long-term instructions saved by Agent: writing preferences, vetoed proposals, and content directives. They are injected into future chats and available to Shadow review; only active entries take effect. Memories Agent records in chat appear here, and you can add your own manually.
